tool_args.rationale: The first probe broke the near-collinearity between drive amplitude and gradient attenuation by extending s_grad to 0.2–2.4. The remaining ambiguity is temporal: a terminal readout near one horizon can reflect stronger coupling or slower memory decay. Acquire the trajectory batch to separate those effects before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-driven memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The gradient probe broadened sink attenuation coverage, but the seven observations still sample only H = 0.38–0.52. Memory coupling and relaxation time can trade off over this narrow horizon window.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a snapshot balance or static siphon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model represents the endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag indicated by the pilot signatures.
It does not constrain the memory dynamics.
